title: Homogeneous Banach spaces as Banach convolution modules over $M(G)$
summary: We develop an elementary approach to convolution and Fourier analysis on a locally compact Abelian group (G), based on bounded measures and bounded uniform partitions of unity. In earlier work, the author introduced convolution and the Fourier--Stieltjes transform on the Banach space (M(G)) of bounded measures, viewed as linear functionals, in a direct Euclidean setting. The present paper constructs arbitrarily fine bounded uniform partitions of unity on general locally compact Abelian groups.
